```{r}
library("FunCC")
library(biclust)
library(grDevices)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Loading data

```{r}
load("array_3d_clr.rda")
load("array_3d.rda")
```

# Selecting value for $\delta$

```{r}
options(warn=-1)
res0 <- find_best_delta(array_3d_clr, delta_min = 0.01, delta_max = 1, num_delta = 20)
res1 <- find_best_delta(array_3d, delta_min = 1, delta_max = 8, num_delta = 20)
options(warn=0)
```

Adding metrics

```{r}
n_curve <- dim(array_3d)[1] * dim(array_3d)[2]
res1$percent_not_assigned <- 100 * res1$not_assigned / n_curve
res0$percent_not_assigned <- 100 * res0$not_assigned / n_curve
```

Percentage of non assigned curves

```{r}
grDevices::dev.new()
plot(res1$delta, res1$percent_not_assigned, type = "o", log = "y")
plot(res0$delta, res0$percent_not_assigned, type = "o", log = "y")
```

Number of clusters

```{r}
grDevices::dev.new()
plot(res1$delta, res1$num_clust, type = "o", log = "")
plot(res0$delta, res0$num_clust, type = "o", log = "")
```

H-score

```{r}
grDevices::dev.new()
plot(res1$delta, res1$Htot_all_mean, type = "o", log = "")
plot(res0$delta, res0$Htot_all_mean, type = "o", log = "")
```

```{r}
grDevices::dev.new()
plot(res1$delta, res1$Htot_sum, type = "o", log = "")
plot(res0$delta, res0$Htot_sum, type = "o", log = "")
```

We take $\delta=4.25$ and $\delta_{CLR}=0.5$.

# Selection of $\theta$

```{r}
thetas <- tibble(theta = seq(from = 1, to = 3, length.out = 10))
n_rep <- 5

res_theta0 <- thetas %>%
  mutate(time = sapply(thetas$theta, function(x)system.time(replicate(n = n_rep, expr = {funcc_biclust(array_3d_clr, delta = .5, theta = x)}))[[1]] / n_rep))

res_theta1 <- thetas %>%
  mutate(time = sapply(thetas$theta, function(x)system.time(replicate(n = n_rep, expr = {funcc_biclust(array_3d, delta = 4.25, theta = x)}))[[1]] / n_rep))
```

Visualisation

```{r}
plot(res_theta0, type = "o")
plot(res_theta1, type = "o")
```

We choose $\theta=\theta_{CLR}=2.3$.

# Computing clusters

```{r}

biclust0 <- funcc_biclust(array_3d_clr, delta = .5, theta = 2.3)
biclust1 <- funcc_biclust(array_3d, delta = 4.25, theta = 2.3)
saveRDS(list(clr = biclust0, original = biclust0), "funcc_package_fits0.rds")
saveRDS(list(clr = biclust1, original = biclust1), "funcc_package_fits1.rds")
```

Creating matrix for cell attribution

```{r}
cell_attributor <- function(fun_mat, res){
  x_y=matrix(0,nrow=dim(fun_mat)[1],ncol=dim(fun_mat)[2])
  i=1
  if(res@Number==1){
    x_y=t(matrix(
      base::rep(c(res@RowxNumber),each=ncol(fun_mat)),
      nrow=ncol(fun_mat))
    ) * matrix(
      base::rep(c(res@NumberxCol),each=nrow(fun_mat)),
      nrow=nrow(fun_mat)
    )
  }
  if(res@Number>1){
    for( i in 1:res@Number){
      xy=t(matrix(
        base::rep(res@RowxNumber[,i],each=ncol(fun_mat)),
        nrow=ncol(fun_mat)
      )) * matrix(
        base::rep(res@NumberxCol[i,],each=nrow(fun_mat)),
        nrow=nrow(fun_mat)
      )
      xy =xy*i
      x_y=x_y+xy
    }
  }
  return(x_y)
}

cell_clust0 <- cell_attributor(array_3d_clr, biclust0[[1]])
rownames(cell_clust0) <- rownames(array_3d_clr)
colnames(cell_clust0) <- colnames(array_3d_clr)

cell_clust1 <- cell_attributor(array_3d, biclust1[[1]])
rownames(cell_clust1) <- rownames(array_3d)
colnames(cell_clust1) <- colnames(array_3d)
```

## Bicluster's coverage

```{r}
funcc_show_bicluster_coverage(array_3d_clr, biclust0)
funcc_show_bicluster_coverage(array_3d_clr, biclust1)
```

Many curves located in the same bicluster, a lot of biclusters with only one curve.

show_cell_clusters <- function(cell_clusters) {
  print(ggplot(reshape2::melt(cell_clust0),aes(x=Var2,y=Var1)) +
          geom_raster(aes(fill=as.factor(value))) + 
          scale_fill_manual(values=col_palette) + 
          xlab('Columns') + 
          ylab('Rows') + 
          labs(fill='Bi-cluster')

}

## Biclusters' curves and mean

```{r}

```

I don't think it helps visualising well the clusters. I think it would be better to characterize clusters with mean and quantiles using depth measure.

# Get all curves of a bicluster

We can obtain all the curves from a cluster this way:

```{r}
bicluster_index0 = 26
stopifnot(0 <= bicluster_index0 & bicluster_index0 <= biclust0[[1]]@Number)

bicluster_curves <- array_3d_clr[biclust0[[1]]@RowxNumber[,bicluster_index0],biclust0[[1]]@NumberxCol[bicluster_index0,],]
```

```{r}
save(biclust1, file = "biclusters.rda")
save(biclust0, file = "biclusters_clr.rda")
```
